description: This file defines and exports the 'imessageSetupPlugin' object, which implements the 'ChannelPlugin' interface for 'ResolvedIMessageAccount'. It composes the plugin using base creation and setup adapters, and references multiple external modules related to iMessage setup functionality.

methods.name: createIMessagePluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base plugin structure for iMessage setup, incorporating provided setup wizard and setup adapter functions.

methods.name: imessageSetupWizard
methods.description: A wizard component or function for iMessage setup process, provided as part of plugin configuration.

methods.name: imessageSetupAdapter
methods.description: An adapter function facilitating the setup process for the iMessage channel within the plugin.
